history.subject: Handoff 14b: the concurrency protocol updated per user instruction — parallel provers via concurrent lean-lsp iteration with lake invocations serialized through the shared mkdir spinlock; disjoint file scopes; the import-list staleness clause. Five agents in flight at this point: E1 (Fable, the σ-normalized comparison), the cech-port w4-1 (Fable, twisted affine Serre vanishing along the rebuild's own engine), deg-D4b B0+B1 (Opus, the diagonal ring core), w4-5 (Opus, the fiber twist Θ_n with two-cover triviality), and the FLV+W6 design pass (Fable, read-only)

Design: the Wave-4 FLV worksheet — fibrewise large-twist vanishing WITHOUT duality and without R^i f_*, by increasing-lattice exhaustion on the π-two-cover: for 𝒪(D + n·F) the section lattices are constant except the u⁻ⁿ-growing one, so Čech H¹ is an increasing quotient chain that exhausts by pole-clearing at the finite fiber while its base has finite codimension (the landed dévissage finiteness), forcing vanishing for n ≥ n₀(D) — per-class and non-effective, exactly the Kleiman-strata default; a degree-arithmetic reduction lifts the fiber case to arbitrary classes of positive degree, so no ℙ¹ base-change identification is ever needed. W6 SPLIT AND HALF-COLLAPSED: W6-lite (h⁰/h¹ of a class, well-defined) is a few lines on landed API (h0/h1_congr + the multiplication isomorphism + extraction) and stops being a campaign; W6-full (the engine-sheaf identification) is real but owned by the datum seam. Six sub-bricks with the single Fable heart isolated (FLV-3 exhaustion endgame); the campaign's one gate is the w4-1 QcohOn interface (mitigated: attached to the port's acceptance + two staged fallbacks so FLV cannot be walled)

(C2) effectivity campaign, E1 first landing: the σ-normalized coherent comparison — packaging and existence, WITH NO GEOMETRIC HYPOTHESES. The Stage-0 design (binding, recorded in the structure docstring): the comparison is a unit 0-cochain θ on a plain pointed-cover common refinement of the two coface pullbacks (no basic refinement — the curve product is not affine), with (N1) the witness relation θ_x · u₁♯γ = u₂♯γ · θ_y, and (N2) the ρ-RELATIVE normalization — D4 amended: 'σ-restriction = 1' is not stateable at the cochain level since rigidification kills only the class; the honest statement is σ♯θ = q₁♯ρ / q₂♯ρ against a section-trivializing cochain ρ carried as a field. Disconnectedness of the étale covers is invisible: every gluing step is the unit-sheaf axiom and the lm:aut bijection holds over arbitrary affine tests — no clopen calculus, no integrality. Existence lands from rigidification + the on-the-nose descent equation alone: the σ-defect of any witness glues to a global unit of the double base, and the correction is division by its projection pullback. Second D4 amendment, sharper than designed: COHERENCE (N3) is a THEOREM about every such datum, not a structure field — the section pins the cochain so rigidly that the triple-coface identity follows from (N1)+(N2), consuming the geometric triple only through lm:aut at the triple tensor. Its full proof is WRITTEN in two header-marked frontier files (ComparisonDefect, ComparisonCoherence — deliberately NOT imported: the closing steps hit kernel deterministic timeouts on the pair-indexed triple-product towers, with three diagnosed continuation options recorded in the headers; no sorries anywhere). Face conventions match Module.IsDescentCocycle on the nose — E2 consumes the datum with zero bridging. Picard/NormalizedComparison.lean, NormalizedComparisonExists.lean (green, imported), ComparisonDefect.lean, ComparisonCoherence.lean (frontier, unimported); root build green, keystones independently verified axiom-clean

Degree lane, W6-lite: cohomology of a Picard class is well-defined, degree by degree — h⁰(𝒪(D)) = h⁰(𝒪(D′)) and h¹(𝒪(D)) = h¹(𝒪(D′)) whenever [𝒪(D)] = [𝒪(D′)], plus the Subsingleton-H¹ and finiteness transports, all through one construction: extraction gives D − D′ = div g, the multiplication isomorphism gives the sheaf iso, and the cohomology transport finishes — finiteness-free, the carbon copy of the landed χ-invariance twin in each degree. The worksheet's prediction confirmed: W6-lite collapsed from a campaign to 137 lines on landed API; the packaged h⁰/h¹-of-a-class deliberately NOT introduced (a choice-of-witness indirection with no consumer — FLV consumes the equalities directly, which is what makes its per-class statements well-posed). RiemannRoch/ClassCohomology.lean; root build green, five keystones independently verified axiom-clean

Wave 4, the cech-port DELIVERED IN FULL — the twisted affine Serre vanishing (G-CBC-3(ii)), the representability wall's one obstruction, is down. The quasi-coherence packaging QcohOn: a fixed-ambient-ring action on sections of every smaller open with restriction naturality, plus the two-lemma IsLocalization.Away form (extension after scaling by a power, killing of locally-dead sections) — deliberately a bare keyed operation with law fields rather than a Module instance tower (the instance form fired the diagnosed defeq risk exactly; the bare form keys every rewrite on the head and needed ZERO transparency escapes where the landed engine needed two). The generalized Serre argument: F-valued Čech one-cocycles on finite basic covers of an affine cobound (partition of unity through the action), cokernel sections lift, hence H¹'(F, U) is trivial on affine U for any QcohOn F U — with the site-level transport one line via the object-cohomology equivalence (strictly cheaper than the landed re-derivation), the structure-sheaf instance for every open, and in-file certificates recovering both landed vanishing statements. Neither general theorem needs the base structure — that was only ever the structure sheaf's own hypothesis. Consumers pinned: the relative two-cover carrier's twisted instances now discharge chartwise; FLV's divisorSheaf instance is K(X)-multiplication + ord bookkeeping. The known-green certificate route worked exactly as designed: a port of the statement along the rebuild's own engine, not a transplant. Cohomology/QcohSections.lean, AffineVanishingQcoh.lean; root build green, five keystones independently verified axiom-clean

Diagonal campaign, B0+B1: the ring-level core, scheme-free. B0 — over the étale factorization k[u] → B: the kernel of the collapse (B ⊗_k B) → (B ⊗_{k[u]} B) is principal on the difference u⊗1 − 1⊗u (by the polynomial telescoping g(p)⊗1 − 1⊗g(p) divisible by the difference, with an explicit section for the reverse inclusion); the k[u]-diagonal ideal is generated by an idempotent (unramified + essentially finite type), lifted along the collapse; and the packaged localization statement — away from the complement of the lifted idempotent, the k-diagonal ideal becomes EXACTLY the principal ideal (u⊗1 − 1⊗u) — stated over an abstract IsLocalization.Away target so the chart sections plug in directly. B1 — the regularity engine: u⊗1 − 1⊗b is a nonzerodivisor in B ⊗_k A for ANY k-algebra A and any b (one composite flat map A[X] → B⊗A sending X − C b to it, flatness preserving nonzerodivisors — the single application avoiding the false general transport), specializing to the diagonal generator; this uniformity in the second factor is exactly what deg-D4c's graph pullback discharges its regularity with. Algebra/DiagonalIdeal.lean, DiagonalRegular.lean; root build green, eight keystones independently verified axiom-clean

Wave 4, w4-5: the fiber twist Θ_n and its two-cover triviality by construction. Θ_n is the class of the local-equation system (t₀ⁿ on V₀, 1 on V₁) on the PINNED two-cover itself, where t₀ is the pulled-back chart coordinate of the map to ℙ¹ — cutting n times the fiber over the point at infinity; regularity because the coordinate is a unit at the generic point of the integral curve (dominance is the honest hypothesis — finiteness was never needed), vanishing exactly on the fiber. The overlap V₀ ⊓ V₁ IS the basic open of t₀ (the private landed fact re-derived publicly), so the transition cocycle t₀ⁿ is a genuine unit there — the two-cover-trivial twist the datum campaign twists by. Power structure Θ_n = Θ₁ⁿ and the degree scaling classDeg Θ_n = n · classDeg Θ₁; the normalization deg Θ₁ = deg π frontiered with the deferred pushforward-rank reading, as designed. RiemannRoch/FiberTwist.lean; root build 8694 jobs, keystones independently verified axiom-clean

Blueprint: 27 nodes across four chapters for the parallel wave's landings — the diagonal ring core (the telescoping and section arguments behind ker(B⊗_kB → B⊗_{k[u]}B) = (u⊗1−1⊗u), the idempotent lift, the localization statement, and the flat regularity engine uniform in the second factor); W6-lite (per-degree class-invariance of divisor-sheaf cohomology with its transports); the cech-port (the QcohOn packaging, the generalized Serre cobounding and cokernel-lifting, the FLV-facing twisted vanishing headline and its site transport — recovery of the structure-sheaf twins noted in prose with no false dependency arrows); and E1 (the section squares, the trivializing-relation calculus, the normalization cover, the σ-normalized comparison packaging and its hypothesis-free existence — the unlanded (N3) frontier deliberately NOT asserted). Kleiman df:rgd read and anchored on the two rigidification prerequisites; inbox I-0143 filed for the unnoded rigidification keystone + relPic machinery cone (a future slice, kept honestly as a prose hypothesis rather than a dangling edge). Parse ok, 1768 nodes, 0 dangling

(C2) effectivity, E1 CLOSED — the coherence theorem (N3) plus both E2 conveniences. The σ-normalized comparison satisfies the triple-coface cocycle identity on the nose: the discrepancy of the three coface pullbacks glues to a global unit of the curve over B⊗B⊗B (no hypotheses), its σ-restriction telescopes to 1 by the normalization and the simplicial coincidences, and lm:aut at the triple tensor kills it — coherence is a theorem about every datum, as the amended design predicted. Plus uniqueness (two normalized comparisons for the same data are equal — the restriction canonicity E2's gluing rests on) and the diagonal seed (the lmul'-pullback of the comparison is 1). The kernel-engineering root causes, both now recorded discipline: (i) the three coface-insertion composites made opaque defs identified once each, with the nested-vs-composite preimage conversion paid once over abstract schemes — no pair statement ever mentions a composite; (ii) THE DECISIVE FIND the first diagnosis missed — variable/include sections with local-notation-typed binders caused the whnf/isDefEq timeouts (the silently-vanishing-declarations gotcha in a new costume); byte-identical statements with explicit binders elaborate at DEFAULT heartbeats. Zero maxHeartbeats bumps in the four new files. Picard/AmitsurProductCover.lean, ComparisonDefect.lean (rewritten), ComparisonCoherence.lean, ComparisonUnique.lean, ComparisonDiagonal.lean; root build 8699 jobs, four keystones independently verified axiom-clean
